description: Information stored on, processed by, or accessible via user endpoint devices is not protected.
applicability: Applies to organizations that allow users to access, process, or store information on endpoint devices (laptops, desktops, mobile devices, tablets) without adequate security controls.

metadata.detection_notes: Review endpoint device policies, endpoint detection and response (EDR) implementations, device management solutions (MDM/UEM), encryption status, and security configurations on user devices.
